Write MEDuSA time-by-voxel matrices or voxel maps directly to 3D/4D NIfTI files

Source: R/nifti_ts.R
write_nifti_ts.Rd

Streams a `time x voxels` (`T x V`) matrix, a `V`-length static map vector, a list of run matrices (such as `deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()$activity`), or a `"medusa_nifti_ts"` object directly into 3D or 4D NIfTI files (`.nii` or `.nii.gz`) in C++, preserving the spatial geometry (`dim`, `pixdim`, `sform`/`qform` affine) of `reference` without allocating full 4D R arrays.

Usage

write_nifti_ts(
  x,
  file,
  reference = NULL,
  voxel_indices = NULL,
  voxel_map = NULL,
  tr = NULL,
  time_offset = 0,
  fill = 0,
  datatype = c("float", "double"),
  compression = 2L,
  orientation = c("time_by_voxel", "voxel_by_time"),
  ncpus = 1L
)

Arguments

x

Numeric matrix (`T x V` by default), numeric vector of length `V` (written as a single 3D volume), list of numeric matrices/vectors, a `"crossrun_decon"` result from [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()], or a `"medusa_nifti_ts"` object.

file

Output `.nii` or `.nii.gz` path, or a character vector of paths matching the number of runs/matrices in `x`.

reference

Path to a reference 3D/4D NIfTI file, an in-memory `RNifti` image/header, or a `"medusa_nifti_ts"`, `"crossrun_decon"`, or `"crossrun_hrf"` object (which also supplies defaults for `voxel_map` and `tr`). Optional when `x` itself carries spatial geometry (`"medusa_nifti_ts"`, `"crossrun_decon"` fit from a `"medusa_nifti_ts"` input, or a matrix from `read_nifti_ts(..., drop = TRUE)`).

voxel_indices

Optional numeric/integer vector of unique 1-based spatial linear indices.

voxel_map

Optional `data.frame` containing `linear_index` (and optional `voxel` column IDs, matched automatically against `colnames(x)` so column subsets or reorderings map accurately to brain space).

tr

Optional positive repetition time in seconds stored in `pixdim[5]` for 4D outputs. Defaults to `reference`'s TR when available, else `1.0`.

time_offset

Scalar acquisition time offset stored in header `toffset`. Default `0`.

fill

Numeric scalar written to non-indexed background voxels (e.g., `0` or `NA_real_`). Default `0`.

datatype

On-disk NIfTI scalar type: `"float"` (32-bit IEEE float, default) or `"double"` (64-bit IEEE float).

compression

Integer gzip compression level in `0..9` when writing `.nii.gz` files (`2L` by default for fast streaming deflate with compact output). Ignored for uncompressed `.nii`.

orientation

Matrix orientation of `x`: `"time_by_voxel"` (default, `T x V`) or `"voxel_by_time"` (`V x T`).

ncpus

Integer number of parallel workers when writing multiple files. Default `1L`.

Value

Invisibly returns a character vector of written NIfTI file paths.

See also

[read_nifti_ts()], [backproject_medusa()], [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()]

Examples

ref_arr <- array(0L, dim = c(4, 4, 2))
ref_arr[1:2, 1:2, 1] <- 1L
f_ref <- tempfile(fileext = ".nii.gz")
f_out <- tempfile(fileext = ".nii.gz")
RNifti::writeNifti(ref_arr, f_ref)

idx <- which(ref_arr > 0)
mat <- matrix(seq_len(5 * length(idx)), nrow = 5, ncol = length(idx))
write_nifti_ts(mat, f_out, reference = f_ref, voxel_indices = idx, tr = 1.2)

rt <- read_nifti_ts(f_out, mask = f_ref)
unlink(c(f_ref, f_out))
